description: Treatment of adult patients with HER2-positive, unresectable locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer who previously received trastuzumab and a taxane, separately or in combination. Patients should have either: (i) Received prior therapy for locally advanced or metastatic disease, or (ii) Developed disease recurrence during or within six months of completing adjuvant therapy.
